race.title: T.A. Morris Memorial Irish EBF Mares Chase (Listed)
race.verdict: It would a major shock if DINOBLUE couldn't comfortably account for her rivals here. A Snow White Park might be able to follow her home. DINOBLUE (FR) A SNOW WHITE PARK (IRE) JOLIE JEWEL (FR)
